Aisha: Morning team — quick microsprint sync for launch tomorrow.

Aisha: What I did: finalized content calendar for Day 1, updated benchmark post copy, locked hero image in CDN.
Aisha: Blockers: still seeing ~150ms p99 extra latency on embeddings endpoint in staging — noticed in bench run; need eng triage.
Aisha: Today: ask eng to check config change (reduce max_batch_wait_ms to 5), Priya to finalize CTAs, Sam to QC mobile layout.

Jordan: @Aisha saw the bench. Can you paste the bench link and the exact run id? I want to reproduce.

Aisha: sure — run id `bench-20240314-04` — doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1abc... (DM me if access issues)

Jordan: cool. Looks like continuous batching holds open a slot longer than expected at low qps. I can try lowering wait_ms; will open a PR. ETA 2-3 hrs.

Jordan: quick Q — do we want to keep quantized model for Day 1 or fall back to fp16 for demos?

Aisha: fallback to fp16 for demo cases where latency is critical. We'll keep quantized for costed API posts. Note in the publish checklist.

Priya: CTA copy options are in the content doc. @Sam can you glance at mobile CTAs? I think we need shorter line.

Sam: Will do — pinging in #design for quick picks. Should have screenshots by EOD.

Lee: Heads up — noticed hero image is 2.4MB in draft, might slow page load. I uploaded optimized version here: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/hero_opt.jpg

Lee: Also flagged one broken alt text in the calendar export (row 12). Fixing now.

deploy-bot: staging-deploy v0.42.1 succeeded — includes bench harness update and logging.

Jordan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/512 — config change + test. @Aisha can you sanity-check the test flag?

Aisha: LGTM — approved. Thanks! If staging bench looks better, schedule a quick roll tomorrow morning before launch.

Priya: I'll queue the social posts for 9am PT once we confirm latency numbers.

Aisha: Thanks everyone — blockers noted. If nothing else, I'll close this thread at noon. :thumbsup:
